description: This file provides extension methods for the IAsyncObservable interface, allowing subscription to observable streams using delegate handlers with various overloads for different use cases, including offset tokens and default handlers.

classes.name: AsyncObservableExtensions
classes.description: A static class containing extension methods for IAsyncObservable to facilitate subscribing with delegate handlers.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: A set of extension methods that subscribe to an IAsyncObservable<T> with various delegate-based handlers for onNext, onError, and onCompleted events, supporting optional parameters like stream tokens.
